findings.description: The subscripts that index the occurrences of argument-1 are flattened onto the baseline, so 'argument-1 subscript 1' reads as a different operand name 'argument-11' (likewise argument-12, argument-1n). Restore them as <sub>1</sub>, <sub>2</sub>, <sub>n</sub>.
